+Adversarial attacks reveal important vulnerabilities and flaws of trained models. 
tests/fixtures/hg_wjc2/fever/producer-readme.body:9: trailing whitespace.

tests/fixtures/hg_wjc2/fever/producer-readme.body:10: trailing whitespace.
+when appended to instances of a class under attack, can trick a model into predicting a target class. 
tests/fixtures/hg_wjc2/fever/producer-readme.body:11: trailing whitespace.

tests/fixtures/hg_wjc2/fever/producer-readme.body:12: trailing whitespace.

tests/fixtures/hg_wjc2/fever/producer-readme.body:13: trailing whitespace.
+nonsensical inputs*, as they simply concatenate triggers to existing samples. 
tests/fixtures/hg_wjc2/fever/producer-readme.body:14: trailing whitespace.

tests/fixtures/hg_wjc2/fever/producer-readme.body:15: trailing whitespace.

tests/fixtures/hg_wjc2/fever/producer-readme.body:16: trailing whitespace.

tests/fixtures/hg_wjc2/fever/producer-readme.body:17: trailing whitespace.

tests/fixtures/hg_wjc2/fever/producer-readme.body:18: trailing whitespace.
+model**. We then train a **conditional language model to generate semantically valid statements**,
